name: notfair_plugin_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the notfair_plugin capability.

prompts.name: seo_analysis_prompt
prompts.template: Analyze the following content for SEO improvements: {content_data}
prompts.use_case: Enhancing website SEO performance with AI-generated strategies.

prompts.name: geo_targeting_prompt
prompts.template: Provide geo-targeted marketing strategies based on this location: {location_data}
prompts.use_case: Creating geo-targeted marketing campaigns for localized audience reach.

prompts.name: marketing_strategy_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a marketing plan with these parameters: {marketing_parameters}
prompts.use_case: Automating SEO and marketing advice for chatbots or AI assistants.

prompts.name: agent_query_prompt
prompts.template: As an AI agent, provide SEO, GEO, and marketing skills response to: {query}
prompts.use_case: Integrating SEO and marketing skills into AI agent workflows for digital marketing tasks.
